name: Saddle
note: Saddle: Replace the dashed stitching with a few soft solid seam lines, and make the stirrups and buckles soft satin grey. Remove the lower fence rail and keep the blue stripes. Keep the saddle's shape and color.

name: Pig Roper
note: Pig Roper: Remove the scattered pebbles and dust specks and make the dirt a smooth, even warm tone. Make the fence and ground slightly darker so the pig is the lightest shape. Light from the upper left so the pig's right flank is slightly darker, and add a soft shadow under each hoof.
